name: Banana Cream II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 oz (57 g / ¼ cup) caster sugar

steps: Mix the cornstarch smoothly with a little milk to form a paste.
Put the remaining milk into a pan with the sugar. When boiling add the cornstarch paste, and boil for about 10 minutes.
Let the mixture cool a little, then add the beaten egg yolks, and stir until they thicken.
Add the vanilla, the bananas. When cool, pour into the prepared mould.
Chill for a few hours to set.
